summary: AISP is a small-cap, software-centric surveillance firm with a light supply chain, but it depends on GPU availability and cloud infra for AI inference. Its recent Fortune 100 win boosts revenue concentration risk, and its thin cash position amplifies fragility.

inputs.fragility: high: allocation priority goes to large cloud/hyperscaler
medium: small customer less negotiating power, but many alternatives

chokepoints.why: AISP's small volume makes it low priority vs. hyperscaler orders

customers.why: Recent 7-figure follow-on contract; likely ~30-50% of revenue

geographic: 100% US-based operations; no disclosed foreign revenue
substitutes: AMD/Intel GPUs (lower AI perf), on-premise servers as backup

bearCase: Fortune 100 contract does not renew or scales back, crushing revenue base.
GPU shortage delays product deployment, causing loss of mindshare.
Security breach destroys trust with US government clients.
Cash burn forces dilutive equity raise at low stock price.

loadBearing.breaksIf: Customer switches to in-house solution or rival (e.g., Verkada)

loadBearing.assumption: GPU supply adequate for small customers
loadBearing.breaksIf: NVIDIA prioritizes hyperscalers; alternative chips lack software stack
Federal budget cuts or privacy legislation restricts procurement

loadBearing.assumption: No major security breach or product failure
loadBearing.breaksIf: Zero-day exploit in Acropolis OS causes data leak; reputation loss

prediction.statement: AISP reports Q2 2026 revenue (Aug 2026) with sequential growth driven by Fortune 100 contract, but guidance disappoints on gross margin due to GPU costs.
prediction.resolutionCriterion: Revenue >$6M and gross margin <55%; stock moves >15% on earnings day

gaps: Unknown GPU supply contracts or cloud provider commitments
No customer count beyond the Fortune 100
verifyThese: Fortune 100 customer is Amazon (likely given e-commerce/transport)
AISP uses NVIDIA GPUs specifically (check recent partnership or bill of materials)
Cash balance and burn rate (last 10-Q shows $9.5M cash, burn ~$3M/qtr)
diminishingReturns: Stopped at GPU supply: deeper hops (HBM, TSMC) affect all AI firms, not unique to AISP; adding no marginal insight for this specific stock.
